mechanism: Select one pair per source component by stable hash before revealing its label: 102 positive oracle seeds and 192 intentionally false controls. Compare fixed TF-IDF/MiniLM ordering against seed-endpoint-first ordering. Hide sibling labels until evaluation. Replay bounded continuation, whole-queue stopping and branch-local stopping. Earlier SVM/calibration work is exploratory and is preserved separately after the direction was corrected to spectral/SVD methods.
